description: Making AI Work: Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak announces the integration of AI into the healthcare system at the UP Healthcare Conclave 2026, aiming for affordable and accessible healthcare for all citizens.
body_lead: UP plans to use AI to transform healthcare, says deputy chief minister Brajesh Pathak Uttar Pradesh govt is focused on having technology-driven, affordable health infrastructure in the state with well-trained workers and technically-equipped primary healthcare system.
